title: Normalize family-index checkout text after preserving encoding drift
failure_signature: The family-index builder emitted its phase-local JSON and Markdown with CRLF checkout bytes, and the Markdown dash was mojibake in the observed shell rendering.
candidate_workaround: Apply an owner-scoped reviewed-current patch that corrects the visible encoding marker and normalizes the two generated files, then rescan UTF-8 and line endings.
recurrence_guard: Inspect generated text bytes and visible headings before staging family-index output on Windows.
rollback: Restore the phase-local generated files from the family index and retain the encoding negative if normalization changes semantics.
scope_boundary: Only the Orin phase-local index rendering is normalized; the installed family skill and historical outputs remain untouched.
